checks.stdout:
usage: maintenance_dev_check.py [-h] --input INPUT --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                                [--base-url BASE_URL] [--model MODEL]
                                [--max-tokens MAX_TOKENS]
                                [--deadline-seconds DEADLINE_SECONDS]

Sequential, DEV-only research driver for automatic register maintenance. This
module owns no server or process lifecycle. The caller supplies an already
available decoder (the CLI constructs the HTTP decoder), and every scheduled
message gets at most one updater call. Gold annotations are loaded only to
validate the authored DEV bank; they never enter updater arguments or prompts.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --input INPUT
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
  --base-url BASE_URL
  --model MODEL
  --max-tokens MAX_TOKENS
  --deadline-seconds DEADLINE_SECONDS

scope: CPU mocks and CLI help only
